summary: All acceptance criteria met, comprehensive implementation of game over screen, parallax backgrounds, screen shake, particle effects, and menu transitions with no real regressions

checks.criterion: Game over screen shows score breakdown (distance, coins, gems, total)
checks.detail: Complete score breakdown implemented in showGameOverScreen() with distance, coin bonus (×10), gem bonus (×50), and total score display

checks.criterion: XP progress bar animates on game over screen
checks.detail: XP bar animation implemented with 1.5s ease-out transition, starts from 0% and animates to current percentage

checks.criterion: Star rating (1-3 stars) displayed based on score thresholds
checks.detail: Star rating system correctly implemented: 1 star for 500+, 2 stars for 2000+, 3 stars for 5000+
All three buttons implemented: Retry calls startGame(), Level Select and Main Menu both call returnToMenu() as specified

checks.criterion: NEW BEST badge appears when beating previous best
checks.detail: Badge implemented with isNewBest check and animated pulse effect, saves to localStorage
3-layer parallax system implemented: sky gradient, far layer (0.2x speed), mid layer (0.5x speed)
Forest and city themes implemented with different colors and shapes (mountains vs skyscrapers, trees vs buildings)

checks.criterion: Background theme changes at distance milestones
checks.detail: getCurrentTheme() switches from forest (0-2000m) to city (2000-4000m+) based on player position
Screen shake system implemented with CSS transforms, light shake for shield hits (4px, 12 frames), stronger for death (6px, 20 frames)

checks.criterion: Coin collection produces yellow particle burst
checks.detail: spawnCollectionParticles called with '#ff0' (yellow) color and 6 particles for coin collection

checks.criterion: Gem collection produces colored particle burst
checks.detail: spawnCollectionParticles called with '#4ef' (blue) color and 10 particles for gem collection
fadeToMenu() function implements 150ms fade-out/fade-in transitions between all menu screens
Particle system capped at 50 particles, efficient rendering order, simple shapes used for parallax layers

checks.criterion: No regression in existing gameplay mechanics
checks.detail: All existing functions preserved, physics and collision detection intact, proper rendering order maintained
